The main takeaway from our work is that

the quiver $\bbZ|_{n-2} Q$ is the quiver that governs the $\tau_n^{-2}$-orbit of $D\bbZ|_{\le n-2}Q$, where $\bbZ|_m Q$ is the truncation of $\bbZ|Q$ at level $m$. This is the first time such an observation is made in representation theory.

the $\mathbb{Z}|_{n-1}$ construction provides a generalization of both the classical $\mathbb{N}Q$-construction of the Auslander-Reiter quiver and the $\mathbb {Z}Q$-type constructions in the literature.
the $n$ translation quiver $\bbZ|_{n-2}Q$ plays a role similar to that of the translation quivers $\mathbb ZQ$ in the classical Auslander-Reiten theory.
